name: Kineticist
source: Written by Vorthas for Monster Builder for Pathfinder 2e, after Pathfinder GM Core's Class Road Maps ("Building Creatures")
license: GPL-3.0-or-later, like the rest of this app; the Pathfinder rules terms it uses are Paizo's ORC-licensed material.
rules: Low to moderate Perception; high Nature, moderate Crafting; high Con; high AC; high to extreme Fortitude, high Reflex, low Will; moderate HP; high accuracy with blasts and moderate damage; high to extreme spell DC (standing in for class DC). Abilities: Two-action Elemental Blast (use Strikes for one-action Elemental Blast, piercing or slashing damage, 30 feet), Channel Elements, armor of metal (counted in its AC), a reaction that deals acid, electricity or piercing damage equal to half its level to an attacker, Metal impulse feats. Junctions: pick one, maybe two, of the element's gate junctions (impulse, aura, critical blast, elemental resistance, skill) for the stat block rather than stacking them all; more is a GM's option for a tougher kineticist

notes.defense: High AC; high to extreme Fortitude, high Reflex, low Will; moderate HP.
notes.offense: High attack bonus with blasts (its spell attack) and moderate damage.
notes.spells: High to extreme spell DC, standing in for its class DC: its impulses work like spells, but it has no spellcasting.
notes.specials: Two-action Elemental Blast (use Strikes for the one-action Elemental Blast, piercing or slashing damage, 30 feet), Channel Elements; armor of metal (counted in its AC); a reaction that deals acid, electricity or piercing damage equal to half its level to an attacker; Metal impulse feats. Junctions: pick one, maybe two, of the element's gate junctions (impulse, aura, critical blast, elemental resistance, skill) for the stat block rather than stacking them all; more is a GM's option for a tougher kineticist.
